# opendeck **A live mission-control dashboard for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) — see every agent, every token and every changed file without leaving the TUI.** ![OpenCode v2](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-v2-111?style=flat-square) ![License MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square) ![Bun](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime-bun-f9f1e1?style=flat-square) ![No telemetry](https://img.shields.io/badge/telemetry-none-success?style=flat-square) ![CI](https://github.com/ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg) ![opendeck: two subagents running live, then the diff and usage pages](docs/demo.gif) ```bash opencode plugin add github:ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck ``` Restart OpenCode, type `/opendeck`. More ways to install: [Install](#install). When OpenCode fans out into subagents, the chat scroll stops telling you what is going on. opendeck adds a compact sidebar and a set of full-screen pages that answer the questions you actually have mid-run: - *How full is my context, and how fast am I burning tokens?* - *Which agents are running right now, what are they doing, and for how long?* - *Is anything waiting for my approval?* - *Which files changed — by which agent — and what did I edit by hand?* ## Features | | | |---|---| | **Context gauge** | `ctx ▰▰▰▱▱ 42%` with in/out tokens, colour shifts at 70% and 85%, compaction warning | | **Live agent tree** | every running subagent as a card or a swimlane: spinner, model, current tool, elapsed clock | | **Approvals** | pending permission requests pulse in the sidebar; full history on the Activity tab | | **Git at a glance** | `⎇ main · 5 files +120 −34` in the sidebar, refreshed on file events — no polling | | **Files by agent** | which agent touched which file; files changed outside any agent are marked `✎` | | **Diff page** | file tree + patch, split or unified, for session edits, the working tree or any commit | | **Git log** | `git log --graph --all`, open any commit's files | | **Opt-in git actions** | stage, unstage, discard and commit from the diff page (`gitWrite: true`) | | **Usage page** | 30d / 90d / 1y token, cache, model and tool totals with a heatmap and daily chart | | **Built for terminals** | one shared 120 ms ticker that stops when idle, scrollable pages, every row fits its width | | **Private by design** | no network calls, no session mutation, secrets masked in tool rows | ## Install Requires **OpenCode v2** (`2.0.0+`) and `git`. [Bun](https://bun.sh) is only needed when you install from source with `--dev` / `-Dev`. After installing, restart OpenCode and type `/opendeck`. The sidebar widget appears automatically (`ctrl+x` then `b` if the sidebar is hidden). ### One command (macOS · Linux · WSL) ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck/master/install.sh | bash ``` This clones the repo into `~/.local/share/opencode-opendeck` and adds that absolute path to the `plugins` array in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` (the file is backed up first, and re-running is idempotent). Pass `--dir ` to install somewhere else, `--ref ` to pin a branch/tag/commit, or `--dev` to build `dist/` from source with Bun. `--uninstall` reverses it, `--help` lists everything. ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck/master/install.ps1 | iex ``` Same options as flags: `-Dir`, `-Ref`, `-Dev`, `-Uninstall`, `-Yes`. It defaults to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode-opendeck` and writes the path with forward slashes. ### With the OpenCode CLI ```bash opencode plugin add github:ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck ``` `dist/` is committed, so git installs need no build step. ### Manual / for contributors ```bash git clone https://github.com/ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck.git cd opencode-opendeck bun install && bun run bundle ``` Then add the absolute path to the `plugins` array in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` (on Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\cli.json`): ```json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json", "plugins": ["/absolute/path/to/opencode-opendeck"] } ``` ### Update / uninstall Re-run the installer to update; use `--uninstall` (or `-Uninstall` on Windows) to remove it, or `opencode plugin remove github:ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck` if you added it through the CLI. ## Screenshots **Agents tab** — the main agent and two parallel subagents, live: ![Agents tab with live subagent cards](docs/agents.png) **Sidebar** — context, git line and agent cards right next to the chat: ![Sidebar next to the OpenCode chat](docs/sidebar.png) **Diff page, git tab** — agent edits next to a hand edit marked `✎`: ![Diff page on the git tab with a manual-edit marker](docs/diff.png) **Usage page** — tokens, cache, models and tools for this project: ![Usage page](docs/usage.png) ## Pages and keys | Page | Open | Keys | |---|---|---| | **Full view** | `/opendeck`, palette, or `⤢ open` | `1` Agents · `2` Activity · `j/k` select agent · `enter` open it · `t` cards/lanes · `pgup/pgdn` `ctrl+d/u` `g/G` scroll · `q`/`esc` back | | **Diff** | `f`, the sidebar git line, or a file row | `1` edits · `2` git · `3` log · `j/k` move · `enter/l` open · `h` close dir · `tab` tree⇄patch · `n/p` hunk · `s` split/unified · `r` refresh | | **Git log** | `3` on the diff page | `j/k` move · `enter` open commit · `pgup/pgdn` `g/G` · `r` reload | | **Usage** | `u` | `1/2/3` 30d/90d/1y · `p` all projects ⇄ this project · `j/k` models · `r` reload | | **Help** | `?` anywhere | every key per page and the symbol legend | There is no default keybind to open the full view (`ctrl+g` belongs to the host's `session.first`); bind your own to the `opendeck.open` command id. All page keys live in keymap modes that exist only while that page is shown, so they never fire over the prompt or a dialog. ## Options Everything is optional; any invalid value falls back to its default. ```json { "plugins": [ { "package": "/absolute/path/to/opencode-opendeck", "options": { "animations": true, "doneLimit": 12, "gitLogLimit": 300, "gitWrite": false, "panels": { "stats": true, "charts": true, "errors": true, "files": true } } } ] } ``` | Option | Default | What it does | |---|---|---| | `animations` | `true` | spinners, pulses, flashes, context tween, launch frames | | `doneLimit` | `12` (1–100) | finished agents listed under Done in the sidebar | | `gitLogLimit` | `300` (50–2000) | commits fetched for the git log | | `gitWrite` | `false` | enables `space` stage/unstage, `a` stage all, `x` discard, `c` commit on the diff page's git tab (with confirm / message prompts) | | `panels.*` | `true` | hide the `stats`, `charts`, `errors` or `files` panel on the Agents tab | UI preferences (collapsed sidebar, cards/lanes, Done open, tab, usage range and scope) are saved through the host's plugin storage and survive restarts. ## How it stays light - **Read-only observer.** It reads the host's session store and listens to events; it never replies to permissions or edits sessions. The only writes are the opt-in `gitWrite` actions. - **No network.** Git runs locally via `git -C ` with a timeout; pathspecs are anchored at the repo root and taken literally. - **One timer.** A single 120 ms ticker drives every animation and stops entirely when nothing is running. The git line refreshes on file, branch and tool events (debounced), never on an interval. - **Secrets masked.** Tokens, bearer headers and `key=value` secrets are masked in tool rows and errors.
Sidebar sections in detail - **Header** — `▾ opendeck · model`; click to collapse. - **Context** — `ctx ▰▱ NN% · in X · out Y`; accent <70%, warning 70–85%, error >85%; spinner while the session runs. - **Git** — `⎇ branch · N files +x −y` (or `· clean`); click opens the diff page on the git tab. - **needs approval** — pending permission requests only; hidden when none. - **Agents** — each active agent on two lines (spinner, name, short model, current tool + argument, elapsed clock). Finished agents collapse to `▸ Done 5 ✓4 ✗1`; click to expand. Click an agent to jump into its session. - **⤺ back to Opendeck** — shown while a return to the full view is pending. - **Footer** — `⤢ open · /opendeck`. Every row is measured against the real slot width, truncated with an ellipsis, and never wraps.
Animations - **Spinners** — braille frames on each running agent and on the `ctx` label; `✓` / `✗` when done / errored. - **Live clocks** — per-agent elapsed time ticks while running. - **Swimlanes** — in lanes mode each running bar's head pulses on a shared time axis. - **Context bar** — tweens to new readings over ~400 ms and shifts colour by threshold. - **Flash & pulse** — new permission requests flash for ~1.5 s; pending ones pulse. - **Fan-out** — a new subagent plays a short `· → ◦ → ●` launch before its spinner. Set `"animations": false` to freeze all of them; clocks keep updating.
## Development ```bash bun install bun run typecheck # tsc --noEmit (strict) bun run test # bun test bun run bundle # rebuild dist/ after editing src/ (commit dist/ with your change) bun run check # typecheck + test + bundle ``` OpenCode hot-reloads file plugins; if it does not, restart it. | File | Role | |---|---| | `src/index.tsx` | plugin entry: sidebar slot, five plugin routes, keymap layers | | `src/state.ts` | reactive store: shared ticker, run tracking, permission and git events, navigation, prefs | | `src/sidebar.tsx` | the compact sidebar | | `src/fullview.tsx` | the full view (Agents / Activity tabs) | | `src/panels.tsx` | Agents-tab panels: charts, tokens by agent, files, stats, errors | | `src/diffview.tsx` · `src/gitview.tsx` · `src/usageview.tsx` · `src/help.tsx` | the other pages | | `src/git.ts` | git parsers (pure, tested) and spawn wrappers | | `src/metrics.ts` · `src/usage.ts` · `src/format.ts` · `src/num.ts` | pure helpers (tested) | | `src/config.ts` | plugin options with defaults | | `script/build.mjs` | Solid transform build | Issues and pull requests are welcome. ## Credits Inspired by [claude-flightdeck](https://github.com/scasella/claude-flightdeck), rebuilt for the OpenCode v2 plugin API. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

# Contributing

Thanks for helping! opendeck is small on purpose, so a few rules keep it that way.

## Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ptthien1012/opencode-opendeck.git
cd opencode-opendeck
bun install
bun run check      # typecheck + tests + bundle
```

Point OpenCode at your checkout by adding its absolute path to `plugins` in
`~/.config/opencode/cli.json`, then restart OpenCode.

## Before you open a PR

- Run `bun run bundle` and commit `dist/` — users install the committed build, and CI fails if it is stale.
- Keep it read-only: no network calls, no session mutation. Git writes stay behind the `gitWrite` option.
- Keep it light: no new timers (use the shared ticker in `src/state.ts`), no per-frame git or fs calls.
- Pure logic goes in `src/*.ts` with a test in `test/`; views stay in `src/*.tsx`.
- Every row must fit its width and never wrap; check a narrow terminal (~80 cols).

Small, focused PRs get merged fastest. For bigger ideas, open an issue first.
